intros.christmas-list: This is an example Christmas wish list. Copy it to your account, swap in your own gifts, and send the link to family - they will see what is already claimed, so nobody buys the same thing twice.
intros.secret-santa-list: This is an example Secret Santa wishlist. Copy it to your account, keep 3-5 gifts within your group's budget, and send the link to the organizer or the group chat - your Secret Santa will know what to get.
intros.kids-christmas-list: This is an example kids' Christmas list for ages 6-9. Copy it to your account, add the wishes from your child's letter to Santa, and send the link to grandparents and godparents - they will see what is already claimed, so nobody buys the same thing twice.
